prd_facts.fact: Discounts apply in this order: category sale, buy-x-get-y, percent coupon, bundle, fixed coupon, free-shipping flag; each step works on what the previous steps left.
A percent coupon takes its percent off the current value of the eligible lines, rounded half up to cents once for the coupon.
A bundle gives its fixed amount off for every complete set of its SKUs in the cart.
The product rules were right and are not rewritten: the code was wrong, so no rule meaning changes.
